A [[human]] '''trooper''' served as a [[ISB tactical agent|tactical agent]] for the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[1 BBY]], while on guard at the [[Lina Soh Hospital]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], the [[trooper]] was [[Death|killed]] by a disguised [[Kleya Marki]] as<ref name="MIS" /> he<ref name="MIS AD" /> attempted to ask a query to the [[Axis network|rebel]].<ref name="MIS" />
